name: Kizuna
source:
A girl who has been asleep for 150 years in suspended animation. The name "Kizuna" was taken from the word "KIZUNA" inscribed on her machine. 

Kizuna has excellent athletic and analytical skills and is well-liked by animals. She is also highly skilled in combat. She has a habit of calling close friends by their nicknames and calls Hidetaka "Hi-kun."
